lines.text: Many learners say: I drink medicine when I am sick.
Better: I take medicine when I am sick.

data.wrong: I drink medicine when I am sick.
data.right: I take medicine when I am sick.

native.tip: Tiếng Việt nói “uống thuốc”, nhưng tiếng Anh nói “take medicine.”

en.caption: Do you often say this? “I drink medicine when I am sick.” With medicine, use “take”: “I take medicine when I am sick.” Listen to Carlos read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
